title: Reentrancy attack in `authorizedOpenPacket()` allows duplicates
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  There is a critical reentrancy vulnerability in the interaction between `CardAllocationPool.sol` and `Packet.sol` when handling **OPEN_PACKET** burn types. This vulnerability enables attackers to receive multiple sets of NFT cards for a single packet.
